description: This file contains test utility functions for Flutter widget tests, including initialization of sqflite for testing, a custom pump and settle function for widget testing, and cleanup routines for app dependencies such as download engines and database closure.

classes.name: AppDependencies
classes.description: A class that holds references to app-wide dependencies such as download engine and database.

methods.name: initSqfliteFfiForTests
methods.description: Initializes sqflite to use the FFI implementation for testing, preventing hangs on CI.

methods.name: pumpAndSettleBounded
methods.description: Advances the widget tester until idle or until a maximum duration is reached, to ensure the app is in a steady state during tests.

methods.name: disposeAppDependencies
methods.description: Cleans up app dependencies like canceling download timers and closing the database after tests.
